result.details: After the first overlap rejection, server_tp was patched to place K writer input on cores (0,0)..(7,3) and V writer input on (0,4)..(7,7). The resident-server probe did not return after more than 10 minutes with server_tp busy in the handler. Client was killed and serve_tp.sh stop required SIGTERM after graceful shutdown timed out.

workflow_decision: Invalidate this production-path fused-cache variant. Do not claim a speedup. Move to a smaller isolated compatibility probe or to the next trace-body hypothesis.

server_recovery.note: qb2 persistent server was restarted after the timeout.
